system.roleplaying: Your powers are so strong they can even scare you sometimes, but you work hard to control them. You can wield those powers to intimidate others.
system.minorTwist: How do you restrain yourself from unleashing your full power?
system.majorTwist: What major damage do you inflict in the process of saving the day?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Great Power
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a situation using one of your highest rated powers and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
